## 1. New LLM Versions / Major AI Lab Tools
- 2026-04-21 — [Deep Research Max: a step change for autonomous research agents](https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/models-and-research/gemini-models/next-generation-gemini-deep-research/). Google put Deep Research and Deep Research Max into public preview for paid Gemini API users, powered by Gemini 3.1 Pro. The release adds MCP support, mixed web/private-data research, editable planning controls, and native chart/infographic generation. Why it matters: Google is hardening autonomous research agents into an enterprise toolchain, not just a chat feature.
- 2026-04-21 — [Scaling Codex to enterprises worldwide](https://openai.com/index/scaling-codex-to-enterprises-worldwide). OpenAI launched Codex Labs, named Accenture, PwC, Infosys, and other deployment partners, and said Codex reached 4 million weekly active users. Why it matters: OpenAI is shifting Codex from individual developer usage toward enterprise distribution and implementation at scale.
